register.invalid.email: This email is already in use
email.verify.subject: Verify Your Email Address
email.verify.title: Welcome to Songbooks of Praise!
email.verify.preheader: Verify your email to get started
email.verify.body: Thank you for registering with Songbooks of Praise. To complete your registration and access all features of our worship management system, please verify your email address by clicking the button below.
email.verify.info: This verification link will expire in 24 hours. If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.
email.verify.footer: If the button above doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser.
email.verify.invalid: Verification token is invalid or has expired
email.editor.removed.subject: Editor Access Removed
email.editor.removed.title: Editor Access Changed
email.editor.removed.preheader: Your editor access has been updated
email.editor.removed.body: This is to notify you that your editor access to the songbook "%s" has been removed.
email.editor.removed.info: If you believe this was done in error, please contact your administrator.
email.editor.removed.footer: Thank you for your contributions to this songbook.
email.editor.added.subject: You've Been Added as an Editor
email.editor.added.title: New Editor Access Granted!
email.editor.added.preheader: You can now edit a songbook
email.editor.added.body: You have been granted editor access to the songbook "%s". You can now add, edit, and manage songs in this collection.
email.editor.added.info: Log in to your account to start editing and contributing to this songbook.
email.editor.added.footer: Thank you for being part of our worship community.
email.songbook.verified.subject: Songbook Published Successfully
email.songbook.verified.title: Your Songbook is Now Live!
email.songbook.verified.preheader: Your songbook has been verified and published
email.songbook.verified.body: The songbook "%s" has been verified by our team and is now publicly available in the Songbooks of Praise library.
email.songbook.verified.info: Users can now discover and use your songbook for worship services.
email.songbook.verified.footer: Thank you for contributing to our growing collection of worship resources.
email.songbook.sent_to_verify.subject: Songbook Pending Verification
email.songbook.sent_to_verify.title: New Songbook Awaiting Review
email.songbook.sent_to_verify.preheader: A songbook has been submitted for verification
email.songbook.sent_to_verify.body: The songbook "%s" has been submitted and is awaiting your review and verification.
email.songbook.sent_to_verify.info: Please review the content to ensure it meets our quality standards before publishing.
email.songbook.sent_to_verify.footer: Thank you for your service as a moderator.
email.songbook.rejected.subject: Songbook Review Update
email.songbook.rejected.title: Songbook Not Approved
email.songbook.rejected.body: After careful review, the songbook "%s" has not been approved for publication at this time.
email.songbook.rejected.info: Please review our content guidelines and make necessary revisions before resubmitting. If you have questions, contact our support team.
email.songbook.rejected.footer: We appreciate your understanding and look forward to your updated submission.
